A LESSON WITH PURPOSE

Understand it.
Then own it.

01

Start with the question

Bring a topic, a tricky problem, or a goal. Establish what already makes sense and where you need clarity.

02

Build the idea together

Use examples, explanations, and guided practice. Ask questions throughout the lesson.

03

Try it independently

Apply the idea to a new problem, then review the approach and choose what to practise next.
